subject: math
question: 设 $a_{n} = n\sin (2\pi en!)$ ，求 $I = \lim_{n\to \infty}a_n$ 与 $J = \lim_{n\to \infty}n(a_n - I)$ 。
answer: I = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} a _ {n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + o \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right) = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \cdot \left(\frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + o \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right) = 2 \pi .

steps.text: 分析 由于 $\sin (2k\pi + \alpha) = \sin \alpha (k \in \mathbb{Z})$ ，所以化简 $\sin (2\pi e n!)$ 的关键是要将 $e n!$ 表示为整数加真分数的形式，为此可将 $e$ 做泰勒展开.

I = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} a _ {n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + o \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right) = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \cdot \left(\frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + o \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right) = 2 \pi .

\begin{array}{r l} J & = \lim _ {n \to \infty} n (a _ {n} - I) = \lim _ {n \to \infty} n \left[ n \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + \frac {2 \pi}{(n + 1) (n + 2)} + o \left(\frac {1}{n ^ {2}}\right)\right) - 2 \pi \right] \\ & = \lim _ {n \to \infty} n \cdot \left[ n \left(\frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + \frac {2 \pi}{(n + 1) (n + 2)} + o \left(\frac {1}{n ^ {2}}\right)\right) - 2 \pi \right] (\because \sin x = x + o (x)) \\ & = \lim _ {n \to \infty} n \cdot \left(- \frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + \frac {2 \pi n}{(n + 1) (n + 2)} + o \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right) = 0. \end{array}

solution.final_answer: I = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} a _ {n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + o \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right) = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \cdot \left(\frac {2 \pi}{n + 1} + o \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right) = 2 \pi .
